daily.brief: 這段時間324則帖文來自66個帳號，看好157對看淩51，多頭聲音仍然明顯較多。共同看好最齊的是$TSLA，CFO提到四年來最高車輛積壓，也有人把它當賺錢工具。共同看淩集中在$BA，第三季虧損擴大並下調交付指引後股價大跌。分歧較明顯在$SPY和$QQQ，有人看反彈有人擔心泡沫。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好最齊的是$TSLA（10好0淩，33次提及）。@TheTranscript_轉述CFO Vaibhav Taneja：Tesla在Q3結束時擁有四年來最高的車輛積壓訂單，交付主要受生產限制（原帖）。@ripster47強調心理價位突破做多策略，連9歲小孩也能交易，近期一直是賺錢工具（原帖）。@RedDogT3則說是他社區管理的良好焦點（原帖）。

$SOFI也有3個帳號共同看好，財報後有聲音認為應高於35美元。@StockSavvyShay指財報顯示為何該股應高於35美元（原帖）。@TrendSpider報導經調整每股盈利0.18美元超預期，營收13.71億美元，會員增至1710萬，上調2027指引，盤前漲9%（原帖）。$BE、$AMZN也有共同看好聲音，談AI基礎設施相對記憶體的優勢。

共同看淩

共同看淩最集中的是$BA（0好3淩，7次提及）。@KobeissiLetter報導第三季淨虧損並下調指引後下跌超過10%，有望創下自2025年4月以來最大單日跌幅，今日市值損失150億美元（原帖）。@StockSavvyShay指下跌10%因下調2026年飛機交付展望，737 MAX及787生產爬坡時間長於預期，預期今年737交付量低於約500架目標（原帖）。@TrendSpider報導經調整每股虧損0.34美元遜於預期（原帖）。

分歧

$SPY 2好4淩，15次提及。@PeterLBrandt詢問有人對圖表形態感興趣，以設置年終股市反彈（原帖）。但@WallStJesus指出關鍵CTA翻空觸發點在7532（根據GS）（原帖）。

$NVDA 3好1淩，26次提及。@firstadopter說媒體宣揚不懂數字的謬論，嚇怕人們不敢投資AI這個一生最大的長期增長故事，Nvidia股價自2023年以來上升14.8倍（原帖）。@Beth_Kindig分享Anthropic引言，企業客戶從Claude獲得有吸引力投資回報（原帖）。

$QQQ 1好3淩。@saxena_puru認為納指往績市盈率約28倍，不應與2000年科網泡沫190倍相比（原帖）。但@KeithMcCullough表示AI泡沫已在破裂，最壞情況可能尚未到來（原帖）。

其他值得留意

數據範圍是這段時間324則帖文（307原創、17轉發）、66個帳號，看好157對看淩51，清晰觀點帳號38個。最多人講是$TSLA（33次）、$NVDA（26次）和$SPCX（17次）。以上只整理公開帖文觀點，非投資建議。

今日市場速覽

324則帖文、66個帳號，看好157對看淩51。共同看好最齊的是$TSLA，CFO提到四年來最高車輛積壓訂單。共同看淩集中在$BA，財報虧損擴大並下調交付指引後大跌。$SOFI財報超預期有人看高於35美元。$NVDA和$SPY有分歧。非投資建議。

daily.brief: In this window 324 posts from 66 accounts show 157 bullish views versus 51 bearish, with bulls still louder. Strongest joint bullish is $TSLA, with the CFO citing the highest vehicle backlog in four years and some treating it as a consistent money maker. Joint bearish concentrates on $BA after a wider Q3 loss and lowered delivery guidance sent shares sharply lower. Splits are clearer on $SPY and $QQQ, with some eyeing a bounce and others worried about a bubble.
daily.full:
Consensus

Strongest joint bullish is $TSLA (10 bulls 0 bears, 33 mentions). @TheTranscript_ relayed CFO Vaibhav Taneja: Tesla ended Q3 with the highest vehicle backlog in four years, with deliveries mainly production-constrained (post). @ripster47 emphasized a psychological level breakout long strategy that even a 9-year-old can trade, and it has been a money maker recently (post). @RedDogT3 called it a good focus for his community management (post).

$SOFI also has 3 accounts jointly bullish, with voices saying the earnings show why the stock should be above $35. @StockSavvyShay noted the earnings show why the stock should be above $35 (post). @TrendSpider reported adjusted EPS of $0.18 beating expectations, revenue $1.371B, members up to 17.1M, raised 2027 guidance, up 9% pre-market (post). $BE and $AMZN also have joint bullish voices on AI infrastructure advantages over memory.

Joint Bearish

Joint bearish concentrates on $BA (0 bulls 3 bears, 7 mentions). @KobeissiLetter reported shares down more than 10% after a Q3 net loss and lowered guidance, on track for the biggest single-day drop since April 2025, losing $15B in market cap today (post). @StockSavvyShay said the 10% drop was due to lowered 2026 aircraft delivery outlook, with 737 MAX and 787 ramp taking longer than expected, expecting 737 deliveries below the ~500 target (post). @TrendSpider reported adjusted loss of $0.34 per share worse than expected (post).

Splits

$SPY 2 bulls 4 bears, 15 mentions. @PeterLBrandt asked if anyone is interested in the chart pattern for a year-end stock market bounce (post). But @WallStJesus pointed out the key CTA flip-to-short trigger at 7532 per GS (post).

$NVDA 3 bulls 1 bear, 26 mentions. @firstadopter said the media is pushing number-illiterate fallacies that scare people from investing in AI, the biggest long-term growth story of a lifetime, noting Nvidia is up 14.8x since 2023 (post). @Beth_Kindig shared an Anthropic quote on attractive returns for enterprise customers from Claude (post).

$QQQ 1 bull 3 bears. @saxena_puru noted the Nasdaq trailing PE is about 28x versus ~190x in March 2000, so today should not be compared to the dot-com bubble (post). But @KeithMcCullough said the AI bubble is already bursting and the worst may not be here yet (post).

Other Notable

Data range is 324 posts (307 originals, 17 reposts) from 66 accounts in this window, 157 bullish vs 51 bearish views, 38 accounts with clear views. Most discussed are $TSLA (33), $NVDA (26) and $SPCX (17). This only organizes public post views, not investment advice.
